tasks.title: Stand up the project-management system and dashboard
Make the repository tooling aware of project-management/
Current-state audit of the repository
Corrected re-audit — separate legacy WordPress, migration data, and the new Node.js application
Give the cron sweeps’ advisory locks connection affinity
Enforce a fingerprint salt in production without breaking existing fingerprints
Keep key-access history when a licence key is deleted
Detect staff refresh-token replay and revoke the session; throttle the refresh route
Make staff deactivation and logout take effect immediately
Role-scope review of staff routes that carry no @Roles
Two-person approval for bulk licence export
Decide whether an emailed order link may pay from another device
Separate and expire the order/cart link HMAC; drop the unused refresh secret
Resolve the Release 1 payment line-up (CONSENSUS-0001)
Implement Final Processor for checkout and admin
Backup policy and a recorded restore drill
Error reporting and alerting, including the delivery-latency target
Write the rollback and cutover runbooks
Reproducible deploys: container definitions or Coolify config as code
Decide where scheduled work runs: API process or the BullMQ worker
Confirm or reverse the Meilisearch replacement (DEC-0009)
Plan the legacy key migration into the vault and the scrub of the source (CONSENSUS-0002)
Import legacy customers and orders with forced password reset
Cutover rehearsal on staging: 301 map crawl and zero broken links
Owner decision — which legacy customers, orders and licence keys migrate
Plan the staging-to-production transition of the single Coolify environment
Analytics tracking plan compatible with the CSP and the third-party budget
Reconcile the performance budgets and cover product, category and checkout on mobile
End-to-end test: card order to licence delivered
Replace the stale MASTER.md with a design-system document generated from tokens.css
Load Tajawal in the admin panel
Server-side session gate for admin pages
Correct stale facts in deployment.md
Agent OS V2 migration (CR-0003, stages M0–M11)
Verify the .claude/agents definitions in a fresh session: tool restrictions hold, shaping and reviews run on them
Guard: detect script-based writes (node -e, python -c) to protected paths, or document an allowlist
Remove PROJECT_CONFIG.file_ownership (superseded by routing.json domains) and the V1 sync entry point after one release
Prune retired staff refresh-token hashes and dead staff sessions
Keep API env keys set in the repo env file: add FX_REFRESH, FX_RATES_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to the schema
Replace hardcoded colours in footer.css (then catalog, contact, account, warranty CSS) with tokens; fix failing contrast pairs
Send stocked licences automatically on payment (risk-gated, idempotent)
Deactivating a staff account revokes all of its sessions
Give the Lighthouse CI job a database, API and fixed seed; cover product, category and cart on mobile and desktop
Apply the licensed Envato (MediCore) admin template design system to the whole admin panel
Order detail page: customer, payment, delivery, keys, notes and customer messaging actions in the admin
pm CLI: let a reviewer or manager formally invalidate a review (append-only), so a fake PASS stops counting
WhatsApp social-button hover: white icon on #25d366 is 1.98:1 (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1); use a dark icon or a border-only hover
Newsletter error text is 3.92:1 where the card fades to teal (WCAG 1.4.3); add --color-danger-ink and use it
Restrict the READONLY role to catalogue reads and make StaffGuard deny routes without explicit roles
First-party analytics: a server-fed events table for the funnel, no browser scripts
Analytics visitorId: random daily salt kept in the database and deleted after the day, instead of a key derived from JWT_ACCESS_SECRET
pm CLI: refuse same-status transitions and unknown flags so no-op and accidental events never reach the log
Newsletter confirm/unsubscribe links: sign with LINK_SIGNING_SECRET under their own purposes; confirm expires in 7 days, unsubscribe never
Agent containment beyond the command guard: OS-level sandbox or allowlisted shell, so destructive, secret-read and state-write bypasses (REV-0113, REV-0115) are impossible rather than parsed
Bring the storefront within its performance budget on real data (perf >= 0.95, mobile LCP <= 1.8 s, <= 60 requests), then make the Lighthouse CI job blocking again
